supported_scope: The two uniform product gaps inherited from the assumed scalar gaps.

limitations: The precise Demailly 2012 locators remain unverified and are not claimed as checked evidence.

decisive_checks: The x estimate is unchanged by scaling the y metric; all remaining product energy is nonnegative.
The weighted adjoint derivative of log(G0*h) cancels the connection-term adjoint.
The curvature commutator eigenvalue is sum_J lambda_j at top holomorphic degree.
A form-core Cauchy argument extends the lower-bound inequality without requiring integrability of an upper curvature term.
